specs.title: Scenario: NGO successfully updates project details

stdout.text: GIVEN an NGO owns an existing project
WHEN  the NGO submits updated title and volunteer count
THEN  the API saves changes and returns the updated project

specs.title: Scenario: Another NGO cannot edit this project

stdout.text: GIVEN a different NGO tries to edit someone else's project
WHEN  they send a PUT request with new data
THEN  the API blocks the request with 403

specs.title: Scenario: NGO marks project as completed

stdout.text: GIVEN an NGO has an active project
WHEN  the NGO sets the status to completed
THEN  the project status is updated and confirmed

specs.title: Scenario: Invalid status value is rejected

stdout.text: GIVEN an NGO tries to set an unsupported status
THEN  the API rejects it with 400 and lists valid values

specs.title: Scenario: Owner deletes their project

stdout.text: GIVEN an NGO owns a project they want to remove
WHEN  the NGO sends a DELETE request
THEN  the project is removed and a success message returned

specs.title: Scenario: Non-owner cannot delete the project

stdout.text: GIVEN a different NGO tries to delete someone else's project
WHEN  they send a DELETE request
THEN  the API returns 403 Not Authorized

specs.title: Scenario: Anyone can view all projects from a specific NGO

stdout.text: GIVEN an NGO has published multiple projects
WHEN  a user visits that NGO's public profile
THEN  all of that NGO's projects are returned

specs.title: Scenario: NGO with no projects returns empty list

stdout.text: GIVEN a new NGO that has not created any projects
THEN  an empty projects array is returned with 200
